target: Preserve a twelve-month average funding response in million USD per percentage point through supplied-moment inversion, boundaries and replay.
model: Authored normal residual inequalities, a nonorthogonal fitted-nuisance example, finite household/inclusion truth and an annual profit scenario.
observation_law: Fixed generated summaries and five feature-clock rows. No bank observations or random final draws.
sampling_unit: A request slot. The scientific context declares dependent monthly origins; the service does not validate that law. The independent Gaussian toy reference has its own expressly different law.
method: All 29 cases via library and CLI, initially and after restart; two changed-horizon conflicts; compare complete outputs with fixed analytic references.
assumptions: The ratio is causal only under external identification and normalization premises.
Covariance, identity/inclusion and local linearity are supplied, unverified declarations.
Known Gaussian references illustrate arithmetic and a specific variance law, not arbitrary fitted/dependent validity.
uncertainty_claim: Nominal Gaussian supplied-covariance inversion; preserve pointwise versus Bonferroni labels. No empirical coverage study, general joint estimated-nuisance result or decision qualification.
alternatives: Fixed versus joint fitted-nuisance covariance under the exact example
Analytic residual inequalities versus runtime inversion
Record versus household units; unweighted versus known-probability HT expectation
Library versus CLI and restart replay
Full effect/profit set versus favorable point answer
metrics: Every attempted slot, expected dispositions/errors and preserved topologies
Exact context, units, sampling labels, assumptions, uncertainty qualifications and all-field parity excluding only request_id
Invocation and active-runner wall time; separate process high-water RSS

acceptance_rules.pass: All 118 slots and 29 four-response parity comparisons match the frozen expectations.
acceptance_rules.negative: Any mismatch is retained and reviewed; do not change fixtures to match responses.
acceptance_rules.execution_failure: Preserve checkpoint and all failed attempts; no replacement or favorable-only denominator.

seed_role: Fixture version only; no random sampling

derivation_review.anchor: Author approval of the exact scoped design

successor_review.anchor: Author approval of the exact scoped design

screen_operating_characteristics: Fixed authored boundary conformance only; no estimated power, coverage or false-acceptance probability.
width_and_availability_rules: Retain empty, singleton, rays and whole-line sets. Refusals are unavailable estimates. Narrow sets on unverified inputs cannot establish useful financial precision.
fresh_data_provenance: New deterministic fixtures and isolated library/CLI artifact roots; no empirical held-out claim.

fixtures.anchor: Exact input contexts, body errors and independent expected outcomes

decision_chain.business: Evaluate a quarter-point deposit-rate increase over the next twelve months.
decision_chain.target: Average retained balance, not endpoint balance; one-pp normalization with separate local-linearity premise.
decision_chain.clock: Feature event<=available<decision; outcomes have separate later follow-up/censoring requirements.
decision_chain.information: Dated household map, inclusion/population, proxy/quote/outcome meanings and covariance provenance.
decision_chain.sampling: Monthly dependence and overlapping horizons need joint covariance; supplied labels do not prove its validity.
decision_chain.identification: No general continuous/panel identification engine; proxy premises cannot be inferred from moments.
decision_chain.estimation: Runtime inverts supplied summaries; fitting and joint fitted-nuisance derivation remain upstream.
decision_chain.uncertainty: Preserve disconnected/unbounded sets and distinguish Bonferroni coordinate construction from a general joint result.
decision_chain.numerical: Independent factorizations and strict endpoint tolerance; no certified general solver.
decision_chain.decision: Proposed consumer reviews premises and maps the complete set through profit; holds when prerequisites fail. This decision layer is not implemented by the local screen.

cost_accounting.scenario: USD 6500 baseline repricing plus USD 500 workflow; profit=3750*beta-7000 under stated annual balances/spreads.
cost_accounting.measured: Every invocation including worker/CLI startup, replay and failures; active runner import/journal time; separate parent/child peak RSS.
cost_accounting.excluded_from_timing: Inter-segment idle time, initial interpreter/module startup, author/review/manuscript work and all unexecuted activities.
cost_accounting.money: Scenario inputs only; no measured bank prices, accepted ROI or cost-per-bank-decision.

evidence_classes.local_execution: Registered fixed library/CLI calculation and refusal screen
evidence_classes.independent_reference: Exact inequalities, covariance/inclusion sums and profit endpoints
evidence_classes.contract_double: Future explicit consumer boundary with prerequisite checks; not executed here
evidence_classes.authentic_owner_run: Later owner maps/design/inclusion/follow-up/cost traces and accepted disposition, only if prototype merit warrants expense

limits: No raw-data fitting or joint estimated-nuisance/dependence proof
No verified household identity/inclusion or bank observations
No live model, MCP requalification, language adapter or actual sibling execution
No empirical nominal-coverage or bank-profit claim
Replay/restart is not process-kill or multi-host crash qualification
